message.content: This black-and-white editorial illustration is formatted as a magazine cover titled "TEMPO". In the upper right, red text reads "SBY: SAYA TAHU YANG ANAS LAKUKAN". Below the main title, smaller white text states "EDISI 8-14 APRIL 2013". The main subject is a person in a dark, structured suit and light-colored collared shirt, seated with hands clasped over their lap. A metal-linked watch is visible on their left wrist. The person’s face has been digitally altered: the eyes and mouth are inverted and vertically flipped while the nose remains in its original orientation. This creates an unusual facial configuration where the mouth appears at the top and the eyes appear below it, oriented upside down. To the left, large white and black text reads "KARTU KUNING BUAT SAMAD". The background consists of a vertical-slatted wall and the tops of white upholstered chairs. In the bottom left, a price "RP 33.000", a website URL, magazine details, and a barcode are visible. The entire image is bordered by a solid red vertical stripe on the left edge.
